title: Celebrate Hogwarts at Target for the Holidays with Nearly 350 Exclusives
summary: Target expands its Harry Potter partnership with nearly 350 exclusive products, immersive experiences and early access shopping for Target Circle 360 members.
body_markdown:
This holiday season, Target, in partnership with **Warner Bros.** **Global Consumer Products** , is bringing guests nearly 350 new and exclusive **Harry Potter** -themed products that celebrate the film series’ 25th anniversary. Launching Nov. 7, the collection includes t-shirts starting at just $20, home décor, collectibles and gifts for fans of all ages.


> Whether they’re longtime fans or just discovering the wonders of Hogwarts, we know how much joy the Harry Potter stories and characters bring to our guests and their families. That’s why we’re bringing together exclusive Harry Potter merchandise with thoughtful design and great value — another example of Target’s merchandising authority and how we’re bringing our touch of style and design to one of the most magical fandoms.
>
>
> Cassandra Jones
>
>
> Senior Vice President of Merchandising for Fun101, Target


### Bring Hogwarts home with exclusive clothing, gifts and décor


The assortment is packed with subtle winks to the series that Harry Potter fans will instantly recognize.


Highlights include:


- **Apparel:** Fleece for $50, family pajamas starting at $30, a robe inspired by Harry’s Cloak of Invisibility, and cardigans, zip-ups and sweatshirts for $50 and under, featuring Hogwarts house details.
- **Gifts and accessories:** Heat-reactive journals, games and $8 bag charms make for the perfect holiday gifts or stocking stuffers.
- **Home décor:** Quilts, throw pillows and Hogwarts house-inspired pillow buddies starting at $25, plus themed cotton sheets and wall décor featuring fine etch drawings of each house.


The collection builds on[Target’s broader Harry Potter celebration](https://www.target.com/c/harry-potter/-/N-4sl4y) , which brings Target’s signature style and design to themed treats and fan-favorite collectibles, all at an incredible value.


### Celebrate Harry Potter at Target


Guests will also enjoy in-store experiences and perks.[Target Circle 360](https://www.target.com/l/target-circle/-/N-pzno9) members can shop more than 120 apparel and accessories items online starting Nov. 6, one day before the collection launches.


On Nov. 7, our[Jersey City store will host a special day of wizarding world themed activities](https://www.target.com/c/store-events/-/N-9x2nj) and at other locations, guests can be among the first to shop the new items and receive a free Hogwarts Crest button, while supplies last. A new dedicated campaign will also debut that day, celebrating the collection and all that's in store for guests. Stay tuned, you may recognize a familiar face from the film series!
